_doc: Tells (Dungeon Alive slice 5; known and unknown 2026-11-12; src/tells.py). Brandon: players must pay attention to lore, weaknesses and abilities (stay away from things that confuse; use ranged), and the notes must not give away what a creature is or how to beat it before the hero knows it. Each tell has three parts: 'sign' (what the eye sees), 'does' (what the creature can do to him), 'counter' (what to do about it). How much is said follows family_lore.knowledge: UNKNOWN hears the sign; KIN (its family at Recognise or Forewarned, the kind itself never studied) the sign, 'kin_lead' and what it does; KNOWN (studied, its page opened, or its family at Lore) all three, then what it is made of (tells.lore_lines, winning-build plan 2026-11-13 section 3.1; the sizes and the materials since the 3.5.1 audit, from affinity.damage_profile, the one reading the blow follows): 'weak_one'/'weak_many' with its weaknesses and {size} ('double'), 'bane_tail' (or 'bane_only' when it has no other weakness) with the materials it cannot bear, then one line of what it resists ('resist_one'/'resist_many') and shrugs off ('shrugs_one'/'shrugs_many'), then one of what its nature refuses ('immune', with 'status_words') and falls to easily ('easily', and 'fire_flight' for a beast that fire puts to flight). These are said at KNOWN even of a creature with no tell; then 'known_lead' goes first, so the creature is named before the lines that call it 'it' (bug bash WB-E02). A sign never names the mechanic or the counter. The counter is honest about reach: when the creature can put the effect on the hero from across a room (tells.reach), 'counter_far' is used, or 'far_counter' when the tell has none. 'splits' fills {split_by} from the creature's own splits.by; 'does_weak'/'counter_weak' are for a creature split by a weak blow. The first time in a run the hero sees a kind, its worst tell is said at what he knows; it is said again when he comes to know the kind better. Observe (O) says up to 'max_lines' of them. The 'pack_<trick>' tells are a pack's trick, not an attack's rider (src/packs.py, data/packs.json): a creature has one when its kind's pack has that trick. 'order' ranks the effects, worst first; 'min_chance' ignores an attack effect rarer than this.
far_counter: {He} can reach you from across a room, but only where {he} can see you: keep stone between you until you can close in.

gaze_paralyze.sign: Something about the eyes of {the} makes you want to look away.
gaze_paralyze.does: {His} gaze can hold you where you stand, from across a room.
gaze_paralyze.counter: Keep a wall or a pillar between you. Eyes that cannot see are safe from it, and so is a hero who watches {him} in a mirror shield, as Perseus did.

paralyzed.sign: {The} moves slowly and surely, like a thing that never has to chase its prey.
paralyzed.does: {He} can hold you still where you stand.
paralyzed.counter: Do not let {him} reach you: fight {him} from a distance. If it is a gaze that holds you, a mirror shield turns it.
paralyzed.counter_far: {He} can reach you from across a room, but only where {he} can see you: keep stone between you until you can close in. If it is a gaze that holds you, a mirror shield turns it.

confused.sign: Looking at {the} too long makes the room tilt.
confused.does: {He} can scramble your thoughts until you cannot think straight.
confused.counter: Keep your distance, or end {him} fast. Wax in your ears stops a scream that does it; cold iron stops a fairy's glamour.
confused.counter_far: {He} can reach you from across a room, but only where {he} can see you: keep stone between you until you can close in. Wax in your ears stops a scream that does it; cold iron stops a fairy's glamour.

sleeping.sign: Just watching {the} makes your eyelids heavy.
sleeping.does: {He} can put you to sleep where you stand.
sleeping.counter: Never fight {him} with others close by. Wax in your ears stops a song that does it, and cold iron a fairy's.

frozen.does: {He} can freeze you solid, and frozen, you cannot fight back.

teleportitis.does: {He} can fling you somewhere else on the floor, far from your way out.

feared.sign: Looking at {the} makes your stomach drop.
feared.does: {He} can break your nerve and send you running.
feared.counter: Know where you would run before you fight {him}. If it is a voice that does it, wax in your ears will stop it.

blinded.sign: Everything about {the} seems aimed at your eyes.
blinded.does: {He} can blind you, and a blind hero fights by touch alone.

silenced.sign: {The} moves in a pocket of dead quiet.
silenced.does: {He} can take your voice, and your spells with it.
silenced.counter: Cast before {he} reaches you, or fight {him} with steel.

stunned.sign: {The} is built like a falling wall.
stunned.counter: Do not trade blows with {him} for long.

immobilized.does: {He} can pin you where you stand.
immobilized.counter: Pinned, you cannot run: fight {him} only where you would not need to.
immobilized.counter_far: Pinned, you cannot run: fight {him} only where you would not need to.

splits.sign: {The} looks as if {he} would come apart and keep coming.
splits.does: Strike {him} with {split_by} and there will be two.
splits.does_weak: Strike {him} with a weak blow and there will be two.
splits.counter_weak: Hit {him} hard, or not at all.

revive_once_on_death.sign: The wounds on {the} should have killed {him}, and did not.
revive_once_on_death.does: {He} will not stay dead the first time.
revive_once_on_death.counter: When {he} falls, keep your guard up.

drain_heals_self.sign: {The} watches your throat, not your blade.
drain_heals_self.does: {He} heals {himself} on your blood: every blow {he} lands mends {him}.

weakened.does: {He} can drain the strength out of you.

diseased.does: The wounds {he} gives fester long after the fight.

corroding.sign: Where {the} has passed, the stone is pitted and crumbling.
corroding.does: What {he} touches rots and crumbles: your armour gives way while it lasts.

poisoned.does: {He} is poisonous, and every wound {he} gives keeps hurting after.

regeneration.sign: The old scars of {the} have closed without a mark.

summon_kind.sign: {The} keeps glancing behind {him}, as if {he} expects company.
summon_kind.does: {He} can call others to {him}, a few at a time.
summon_kind.counter: Strike {him} while {he} chants: a blow breaks the call. Kill what {he} calls, and {he} must call again.

pull_chance.sign: {The} has a long reach with a hook to it.
pull_chance.does: {He} will drag you to {him} from further off than you think.
pull_chance.counter: Stay well out of {his} reach, or close in on your own terms.

sp_drain.does: {He} is after your food: every blow {he} lands leaves you hungrier.

can_charge.counter: Make {him} come to you round a corner.

can_phase_blink.sign: {The} is never quite where you last looked.
can_phase_blink.does: {He} steps from place to place without crossing between.
can_phase_blink.counter: Distance will not save you: stand and fight.

stalker.sign: {The} keeps just out of reach and never takes {his} eyes off you.
stalker.does: {He} waits for you to rest. Rest, sleep or lose your wits near {him}, and {he} is on you in a moment.
stalker.counter: Never rest where {he} can find you. Back {him} into a corner, or rest on another floor.
stalker.sign_friend: {The} follows you, smiling, offering to keep watch.
stalker.does_friend: {He} is no friend. {He} waits for you to rest, and then {he} strikes hard.
stalker.counter_friend: Never rest where {he} can find you. Strike first, or rest on another floor.

bleeding.does: The wounds {he} gives go on bleeding after the blow.

burning.does: {He} sets what {he} hits alight, and the fire keeps burning after.

slowed.sign: The air round {the} feels thick, like wading.
slowed.does: {He} can slow you, and slowed, you cannot outrun {him}.
slowed.counter: Choose to fight or flee before {he} reaches you.

hallucinating.does: {He} fills heads with things that are not there, and while it lasts, what you see may not be what is there.

rust.sign: Every nail and hinge near {the} has gone to red dust.
rust.does: {His} feelers rust iron and steel: a brush takes a point off your weapon or armour.
rust.counter: Keep good steel out of {his} reach: fight {him} with wood or bronze.

pack_swarm.sign: You hear claws scrabbling in the dark all round {the}: {he} is never alone.
pack_swarm.does: Rats swarm: each one bites harder for every other rat beside you, so four at once are deadly and one is not.
pack_swarm.counter: Never let the pack surround you. Back into a corridor or a doorway, where only one rat can reach you, and kill the first one fast.

pack_feast.sign: The reek of an opened grave hangs round {the}.
pack_feast.does: When you cannot move, every ghoul near by falls on you to feed, and each bites harder at prey that cannot fight back.
pack_feast.counter: Thin the pack out before it closes: a ghoul that comes alone is no feast. Ghouls will not follow you down a narrow passage one at a time, so waiting there does no good; above all, never be held where the pack can reach you.

pack_hamstring.sign: {The} watches your legs, not your eyes.
pack_hamstring.does: Wolves hunt together: while one holds your eyes, another slips behind you and bites at your hamstring, and a hamstrung hero is slowed.
pack_hamstring.counter: Keep your back to a wall so no wolf can get behind you, and kill one fast so it is never two on one. Wolves will not follow you down a narrow passage one at a time: the pack waits outside it, or comes round.

pack_harry.sign: {The} hangs back and watches you, as if waiting for something.
pack_harry.does: {He} hunts the wounded: once you are badly hurt, the whole pack closes in and bites harder.
pack_harry.counter: Fight the pack while you are fresh, heal before you are down to half, and kill the boldest first.

pack_sling.does: Goblins pelt you with sling stones from afar while more of the pack gathers, then rush you all together.
pack_sling.counter: Close on the slingers before the rest arrive, or keep stone between you and the pack.

pack_traps.sign: {The} carries a coil of cord and a pouch that clinks with iron.
pack_traps.does: Kobolds lay snares and caltrops round a den, and drop more as each one backs away, so whoever chases a kobold steps in it.
pack_traps.counter: Never chase a kobold blindly. Watch the floor where it has just stood, and disarm what it dropped (P) or step round it.

pack_bay.sign: {The} lifts {his} nose and tests the air.
pack_bay.does: Hounds hunt by scent and voice: the first to find you bays, the whole pack comes running, and the hounds follow your scent wherever you go for a while.
pack_bay.counter: Kill the first hound before the rest arrive, or be ready for the whole pack: running will not lose it.

pack_dart.sign: {The} never stands still: {he} circles, yips and edges in.
pack_dart.does: Jackals dart in to bite and back out of reach, each in turn, so you can never pin one down.
pack_dart.counter: Strike the one that has just bitten you while it is still beside you. Never chase a jackal across a room: it is faster than you.

pack_snatch.sign: {The} eyes your pack, and the food in it.
pack_snatch.does: Harpies snatch food out of your pack and fly off with it, as the harpies robbed the table of the blind king Phineus.
pack_snatch.counter: Kill the thief and what {he} took falls where {he} dies. Keep the flock off you, or fight where a harpy cannot swoop.

breath_recharge.does: {He} breathes, then must draw breath again: for a few turns {he} has only tooth and claw.
breath_recharge.counter: Close in while {he} draws breath, or keep stone between you until {he} has spent it.

heals_allies.sign: {The} stays close behind the others, eyeing every wound.
heals_allies.does: {He} mends a badly hurt friend, then must rest {his} voice a few turns before the next.
heals_allies.counter: Kill {him} first, or finish the friend {he} has just mended before {he} can mend again.

life_drain.sign: The air about {the} is thin and cold, like the air of a tomb.
life_drain.does: {His} touch takes life that rest will not give back: your greatest health falls with every blow {he} lands.
life_drain.counter: Do not let {him} touch you often. What {he} takes comes back half with a night's sleep on the next floor down, and all of it from a physician or a strong prayer.
